ranked.headline: Generative and language models learn protein interaction geometry and dynamics
ranked.summary: Learned surrogates for interaction geometry and dynamics are now being applied to antibody design, stability, and conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and bulk methods infer regulatory activity from RNA and chromatin data
ranked.summary: Public single-cell and bulk sequencing resources are now harmonized into reference atlases and annotation tools for regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Explicit error modeling and population-scale benchmarks refine genomic variant inference
ranked.summary: Sequencing and evolutionary processes distort genomic inference, motivating explicit error models and population-scale benchmarks across recent items.

ranked.headline: Scalable inference of phylogenetic networks and ancestral recombination graphs
ranked.summary: Early-2026 preprints and a publication report scalable tools for network, genealogy, genotype, and single-cell phylogeny inference under noisy or large-scale…

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link molecular regulation to system-level dynamics and transitions
ranked.summary: Current work pairs regulatory networks with dynamical models to explain cell-state transitions, oscillations, and cross-domain coupling.

ranked.headline: Multi-feature prediction of genomic elements from pangenome and long-read assemblies
ranked.summary: Long-read and pangenome assemblies are increasingly used as inputs for de novo prediction of chromatin, centromeric, and allele-specific transcript features.

ranked.headline: Protein and genome language models tied to structure, fitness and interaction readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test tokenization, pooling, and decoding in protein and DNA language models against structural and variant-effect readouts.

ranked.headline: Harmonized, FAIR-compliant metadata tools and portals for omics and clinical data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints deliver harmonized metadata annotations, FAIR metadata tooling, and curated portals for omics samples and studies.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and multiscale models of tumor, glioma and electrotactic cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Scalable solvers and stochastic models now capture tumor, glioma and electric-field cell guidance, with released prediction tools.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models integrate and impute spatial multi-omics across modalities
ranked.summary: Incomplete, multi-slice, and multi-technology spatial omics datasets are driving models that encode spatial niche structure directly into learning.

ranked.headline: Sequence language models extend to protein, RNA, antibody, and molecular property tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published model apply transformer-based sequence learning to antibodies, RNA-protein binding, protein homology, and molecules.

ranked.headline: ML and algorithmic design of nucleic acid sequences for sensing, synthesis, and assays
ranked.summary: Computational sequence optimization is being applied before experiments in RNA sensors, long ssDNA synthesis, and multiplex primer assays.

ranked.headline: Assemblies and variant catalogues resolve structural change in diverse genomes
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair reference-quality and population-scale genomes to trace recombination, transposon bursts, and organellar rearrangements across taxa.

ranked.headline: Comparative modeling infers prokaryotic regulons and conserved regulatory RNA structures
ranked.summary: Comparative modeling of prokaryotic genomes now resolves regulatory RNAs and divergent regulon features across lineages.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of genome structure from sparse, noisy sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent papers and preprints apply single-cell and long-read methods to crossover mapping, telomere-to-telomere assembly, and telomere analysis.

ranked.headline: Genome language models predict and design promoter and regulatory element activity from…
ranked.summary: Sequence-based deep learning now predicts and designs promoter and cis-regulatory activity directly from DNA, grounded in experimental reporter measurements.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained MD and flux models probe residue-level contacts in biomolecular condensates
ranked.summary: Residue-level perturbation and non-equilibrium flux models now link sequence features of condensates to molecular contacts and transport.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and CRISPR screens resolve cell-type-specific regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Pooled CRISPR perturbation and single-cell readouts now resolve regulatory effects at cell-type and single-nucleotide resolution.

ranked.headline: Open structure predictors and curated benchmarks extend to peptides and antibodies
ranked.summary: Matched-condition claims for open structure predictors arrive alongside standardized benchmarks for peptides and antibody sequencing.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict RNA splicing, editing, ribosome occupancy and expression
ranked.summary: Transformer, flow-matching and graph architectures now predict RNA-level readouts directly from sequence and chromatin context.

ranked.headline: Stochastic evolutionary models benchmarked against neural and large-scale genomic data
ranked.summary: Parameter-efficient mechanistic models are now tested directly against high-capacity neural methods and genome-scale empirical datasets.

ranked.headline: LLM agents span perturbation prediction, molecule optimisation and drug discovery…
ranked.summary: Early-2026 preprints and a JCIM report test LLM agents on perturbation benchmarks, molecule optimisation and multi-step discovery pipelines.

ranked.headline: Potts threading estimates protein reorganization costs for type II kinase inhibitor…
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair large-scale kinase binding profiles with structure-guided design and proteomic binding-site localization.

ranked.headline: Reduced structural representations speed up protein-ligand affinity and pose prediction
ranked.summary: Coarse pocket, distance-distribution, and similarity-transfer models now target affinity and pose prediction at lower cost than full structural modeling.

ranked.headline: Physical polymer models connect 3D genome organization to regulatory output
ranked.summary: Physical simulations now reconstruct genome-scale and locus-level chromatin organization and predict supercoiling-dependent expression from architecture.

ranked.headline: Attention and graph models are scaling single-cell, spatial, and clinical data analysis
ranked.summary: Billion-parameter foundation models and graph transformers now scale to 48M-cell and whole-slide datasets with interpretable outputs.

ranked.headline: Computational models guide immune-relevant therapy and mRNA delivery design
ranked.summary: Learned and simulated predictions are increasingly coupled to experimental or structural validation across immune therapy and delivery design.

ranked.headline: Open-source simulators for gene regulatory networks and genotype-phenotype data
ranked.summary: Three open-source tools in February 2026 provide controllable simulation and trajectory analysis for gene regulatory and genotype-phenotype data.

ranked.headline: Game payoff structure and network epidemics jointly shape cooperation outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple evolutionary game payoffs to epidemic spread, game switching, and foraging division of labor in structured populations.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines and benchmarks for microbial genome and gene analysis
ranked.summary: Long-read microbial genome pipelines are now paired with controlled benchmarks that evaluate gene detection and essentiality analysis methods.

ranked.headline: Computational detection of mosaic, copy-number and repeat variation at single-cell scale
ranked.summary: Single-cell and population-scale genomes now permit variant calling for mosaic repeats, CNVs and regulatory elements.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling resolves cell lineages and tissue signaling
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell transcriptomes now support lineage tracing and communication inference directly from expression data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell metabolomics and senescence multiomics extend scalable cellular profiling
ranked.summary: Per-cell metabolomics at scale and multiomic senescence resources are emerging alongside computational single-cell analysis methods.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and Nextflow pipelines extend DIA and cross-linking MS peptide analysis
ranked.summary: Most peptides in DIA-MS data sets were previously unquantified, prompting end-to-end workflows and deep learning rescoring for XL-MS.

ranked.headline: Generative molecular design conditioned on learned representations beyond structure
ranked.summary: Preprints from early 2026 extend generative design with synthesizability, macrocyclization, and transcriptomic conditioning, with one published QUBO-based…

ranked.headline: Structure-constrained models decode and reconstruct EEG and expansion microscopy data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show EEG and microscopy models gaining fidelity with fewer parameters, using sub-Nyquist sampling, latent compression, and short fine-tuning.

ranked.headline: Stress, temperature and superspreading as explicit heterogeneity in epidemic models
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints model stress, temperature-driven infection loss and stochastic superspreading as explicit drivers of epidemic behavior.

ranked.headline: LLMs mediate natural-language access to omics and literature-grounded analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM interfaces with inspectable omics, graph, and literature-retrieval outputs rather than free-text answers alone.

ranked.headline: Methylation-based models predict biological age and sex-divergent aging trajectories
ranked.summary: Blood DNA methylation models now resolve nonlinear, sex-divergent aging and clinical biomarkers, with female-specific trajectories linked to cancer onset.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from tandem mass spectra to support metabolite identification
ranked.summary: Large public MS/MS archives and learned spectral similarity models now enable candidate structure proposal and cross-polarity spectral comparison.
